sorries: GX.e0PastHalf_isE0CauchyComplete (l.1676-1692), `⟨e0PastHalfSlice, sorry⟩ -- SORRY(prop:globally_hyperbolic_cauchy_complete_manifolds)`. The sorry is tagged and its obstruction text is precise. The auditor checked the three claims by hand and found each TRUE. (i) {tau = -1} is a Cauchy surface of {tau<0}. tau is non-decreasing along future causal curves, and strictly so unless the curve is constant. A curve with bounded tau has convergent r and theta, because |theta'| <= tau'/r0, or it converges to a BTZ point. So tau sweeps (-inf, 0) along every inextensible causal curve. (ii) The developed slice T = -1 + Y^2/(2(T-X)) has unit timelike normal (Minkowski norm -1), so it is locally a c-Lipschitz graph with c < 1. (iii) The pulled-back metric is |dz|^2 on C, which is complete. So the sorry sits on a true statement, not a false one. It is not on the headline path.
